title: Lane Status
description: Forward-looking replacement shape for a lane's status.json. Added 2026-09-19. Corrected 2026-09-19 after the first real test run against archived eastl output: budget widened to string|object (07/09/13/15 already use a structured budget object; forcing a downgrade to string would be wrong, not rigorous), and the version field renamed from schema_version to schema to match the appsec-review-process/<name>/<version> convention model-config.json and real status.json files already use. additionalProperties is intentionally true for now -- existing lanes (00-09,13,15) predate this schema and have their own idiosyncratic extra fields (e.g. results.scenarios_analyzed); tightening to false is a deliberate later step once lanes are migrated to author findings[] as the single source of truth instead of a separate freehand tally (the exact bug class that caused 07/08's self-reported scenario-count mismatch -- see claude project TODO 'session 9'). Until migration, schema_validate.py treats findings/artifacts_read as present-if-valid, absent-is-a-warning-not-an-error.

budget.description: Real lanes use both shapes today: a plain tier name (older lanes) or a structured object like {selected, max_clusters, ...} or {type, max_output_lines, used_..., status}. Both are legitimate -- do not force a downgrade to string.

next_batch_recommendation.description: Real lanes use both shapes: a plain sentence (most lanes) or a structured object (01, 13) e.g. naming the specific downstream lane and reason. Both legitimate.

schema.description: Matches the convention already used in real status.json files and in model-config.json's own 'schema' field -- not 'schema_version'. Accepts both lane-status and process-status as the middle segment -- 00-intake-recovery predates/intentionally diverges from the lane-status convention as the bootstrap/recovery lane; most other lanes (02,04,06,07,08,09,15) currently omit the schema field entirely, which is fine since it is not in required[].
